verdict.rationale: Postman documents capturing network traffic during Playwright UI test runs and validating those live API calls against Postman Collections. That is a form of checking live traffic against a defined contract. The other evidence covers generic post-response test scripts and linting specs against governance rules, neither of which shows validating live responses against an OpenAPI or Spec Hub contract to detect drift. Missing for 10: documented validation of live responses against an API specification or schema, explicit drift detection or reporting, a CI-driven contract-testing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can validate live responses against the API contract to catch drift
